findings.motion: Second Reading, Senate Bill 747 Election Law Changes (House roll call 542, passed 69 to 47)
findings.note: Voted no on House second reading of S747, a wide election bill. Its text includes photo ID rules for same-day registration, a notation of which ID type each voter used, and a report of jury-duty excusals for non-citizens to the State Board of Elections. His name is in the No list on the roll call.
subjects: non-citizen voting and jury-duty citizenship reports

findings.motion: Veto Override, Senate Bill 747 Election Law Changes (House roll call 596, 72 to 44, became SL 2023-140)
findings.note: Voted no on the House veto override of S747. His name is in the No list on the roll call.

findings.motion: Amendment A12 (Longest) to S747 on second reading, failed 46 to 71; text at https://webservices.ncleg.gov/ViewBillDocument/2023/7087/0/S747-ACH-38-V-2
findings.note: He offered an amendment to S747 that would change a reference on page 5 from the first notice under G.S. 163-82.7(c) to the second notice under G.S. 163-82.7(e). The statute section concerns notices in voter-roll list maintenance. The amendment failed.
subjects: voter-roll checks and list maintenance notices

findings.motion: Amendment A14 (Longest) to S747 on second reading, failed 47 to 69; text at https://webservices.ncleg.gov/ViewBillDocument/2023/7092/0/S747-AST-132-V-1
findings.note: He offered an amendment to S747 to add new G.S. 163-212.5, Falsification of electors, making it a Class D felony to create, serve in, or conspire to create a false slate of presidential electors. The amendment failed.
